title: Coast Guard rescues 2 U.S. citizens from sinking vessel in the Mona Passage
description: The crew of a Coast Guard MH-60T Jayhawk helicopter rescues two men, U.S. citizens, from a sinking 27-foot Robalo vessel in the Mona Passage Feb. 21, 2023.  The survivors, who were reportedly the only two persons aboard the vessel, were transported to Coast Guard Air Station Borinquen in Aguadilla, Puerto Rico. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
